name: Pitel
description: **Pitel** is one of the Arches of Atlas. During the session, its keystone was the first offered to Gerk as a possible choice when the party weighed which Arch to take on. While reviewing their options, the group remembered Pitel as the **elemental Arch**.

log.summary: During the session on 2026-08-03, **Pitel** emerged as a focal point while Gerk weighed which Arch's keystone he might accept. Its keystone was the first one presented to him as a possible choice. While the party reviewed their options, they recalled **Pitel** as the elemental Arch among the Archs of Atlas.
notes: Its keystone is the first one presented to Gerk as a possible choice.
